<!-- 404 page: GitHub Pages serves 404.html for any address that has no file. Quarto writes its links and assets from the
     site root, so they work at any depth; it is left out of the sitemap and the search index, and the post-render step
     adds a robots noindex meta. Styles: assets/pages.css ("404 page"). -->

```{=html}
<div class="nf">
  <p class="nf-path" hidden>Address: <code></code></p>
  <nav class="nf-links" aria-label="Main pages">
    <a class="nf-link" href="index.html"><i class="bi bi-house" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="nf-name">Home</span><span class="nf-what">About me, current work and contact</span></a>
    <a class="nf-link" href="research.html"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="nf-name">Research</span><span class="nf-what">The questions behind my work, and the projects</span></a>
    <a class="nf-link" href="publications.html"><i class="bi bi-journal-text" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="nf-name">Publications</span><span class="nf-what">Journal articles, conference papers and theses</span></a>
    <a class="nf-link" href="learn/index.html"><i class="bi bi-book" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="nf-name">Learn</span><span class="nf-what">Energy Systems, Step by Step: a free interactive course</span></a>
  </nav>
  <p class="nf-search" hidden><button type="button" class="btn-outline"><i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>Search the site</button></p>
</div>
<script>
  // the address asked for, and a button that opens the site search (both need JavaScript, so both start hidden)
  (function () {
    var path = document.querySelector(".nf-path");
    if (path && location.pathname && location.pathname !== "/404.html") {
      var shown = location.pathname;
      try { shown = decodeURI(shown); } catch (e) { /* a malformed escape: shown as typed */ }
      path.querySelector("code").textContent = shown;
      path.hidden = false;
    }
    var p = document.querySelector(".nf-search");
    if (!p || !document.getElementById("quarto-search")) return;
    p.hidden = false;
    p.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", function () { if (window.quartoOpenSearch) window.quartoOpenSearch(); });
  })();
</script>
```
